learning_outcomes.text: Students possess knowledge of the basic structures of measurement systems and their application-specific use.
They are able to calibrate measurement systems and assess the reliability of measurement results.
They are able to evaluate measurement series.

Students possess the knowledge to computer-aidedly acquire, evaluate, and assess measurement data from various application areas such as electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics, process engineering, etc.
Students acquire fundamental knowledge about the essential areas of electrical metrology, measurement errors, evaluation of measurement results, etc.
Students learn to collect and evaluate measurement data, especially in the field of electrical metrology.
The latest state of the art in metrology is taught.
Students learn to discuss measurement results.
Students learn to work scientifically and professionally.

syllabus_topics: Static and dynamic behavior of measurement systems
Measurement errors, computer-aided separation of random and systematic error components
Evaluation and representation of measurement series
Fundamentals of electrical metrology in DC and AC circuits
Structure and operating modes of the oscilloscope
AD and DA converters, sampling theorem
Bus concept: Basic functions and bus topologies
